_README: Label id -> structure name for the body-surface volume built from the Visible Human male cryosections by scripts/cryo/skin_from_cryo.py: the tissue silhouette (everything that is not the blue gelatin), holes filled per slice, largest connected body kept (the colour charts and slice labels photographed beside the body are dropped).
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), male colour cryosections, IDC series 4aaf9181-fb6a-4a4c-bf49-d1eb9ed4a385, registered to the CT (scripts/cryo/README.md).

body_surface.note: Whole-body silhouette at 1 mm; the two in-plane shifts of the CT blocks differ by 2-4 mm and the torso block's is used throughout.
